title: Coinbase Changed How Software Is Built. Here's What Happened.

source.title: Coinbase reduces time from idea to production by 90% with Cursor

reportedFigures.agentCreatedPullRequests: 75% of all PRs, cloud and local
reportedFigures.mergedPullRequestsPerEngineer: +55% since the beginning of the year
reportedFigures.ideaToProduction: 20 days to 1.8 days for some teams (>90% reduction)
reportedFigures.smallTeamScope: teams of 1-2 engineers ship work that once required a full team

qualification: Reported customer outcomes, not universal industry benchmarks. The 20-day figure is introduced as an illustrative typical cycle and is qualified as 'some teams' when attributed to Coinbase.
